import reduceReducers from 'reduce-reducers';

import authReducer from '../reducers/authReducer'
import commentersMessageReducer from '../reducers/commentersMessageReducer'
import commentersSearchReducer from '../reducers/commentersSearchReducer'
import followersMessageReducer from '../reducers/followersMessageReducer'
import followersSearchReducer from '../reducers/followersSearchReducer'
import myFollowersMessageReducer from '../reducers/myFollowersMessageReducer'
import myFollowersSearchReducer from '../reducers/myFollowersSearchReducer'
import receivedMessagesMessageReducer from '../reducers/receivedMessagesMessageReducer'
import receivedMessagesSearchReducer from '../reducers/receivedMessagesSearchReducer'
import sentMessagesMessageReducer from '../reducers/sentMessagesMessageReducer'
import sentMessagesSearchReducer from '../reducers/sentMessagesSearchReducer'
import loginReducer from '../reducers/loginReducer'
import signupReducer from '../reducers/signupReducer'
import uiReducer from '../reducers/uiReducer'

//export default combineReducers({
//  authReducer: authReducer
//});

        
export default reduceReducers(
                              authReducer,
                              loginReducer,
                              signupReducer,
                              commentersSearchReducer,
                              commentersMessageReducer,
                              followersSearchReducer,
                              followersMessageReducer,
                              myFollowersSearchReducer,
                              myFollowersMessageReducer,
                              sentMessagesSearchReducer,
                              sentMessagesMessageReducer,
                              receivedMessagesSearchReducer,
                              receivedMessagesMessageReducer,
                              uiReducer);
